info.name: Shukhee Integration — Consultation APIs
info.description:
Whitelisted Frappe endpoints for the video-consultation flow (`shukhee_integration.api.consultation`) that this app exposes to the SK/patient-facing client. These orchestrate the external Shukhee (SSK) teleconsultation API on the server side — see the separate `Shukhee-SSK-Integration` collection for that vendor's own REST contract, which these endpoints call internally.

## Flow
1. **Start Consultation** — SK taps "Start Consultation". Books an instant call with Shukhee and returns a `call_log` id + `call_url` (open in a WebView/browser to join).
2. **Get Consultation Status** — poll this on an interval while on the video-call/loader screens. Returns Shukhee's own status (`pending/confirmed/accepted/completed/rejected/cancelled/on-hold`); once `completed`, also returns `prescription_link`/`invoice_link` (our own permanently-hosted files, not Shukhee's short-lived presigned links).
3. **View Prescription** — fetches the already-downloaded prescription/invoice links for a completed consultation.

## Auth
All endpoints use this app's `remote_auth` pattern (`uhis_next_core.auth.decorators.whitelist(remote_auth=True)`), not Frappe's own session/API-key auth: a caller-supplied `X-Auth-Token: Bearer <JWT>` header, whose `sub` claim must be a `User` linked from a `Provider` record (`Provider.user`) that has an **active** `UHIS Shukhee User` record.

The collection-level pre-request script below auto-generates an **unverified** dev/test JWT (Phase 1 of `JWTTokenValidator` — signature is not checked, only the `sub` claim is read) from `test_user_email`, so this collection is runnable against a local dev bench without needing a real signed token. Set `test_user_email` to a real `User` name that has a `Provider` and an active `UHIS Shukhee User` record.

## Setup
1. Import this collection and `Shukhee-Integration.postman_environment.json`.
2. Select the **Shukhee Integration — Local** environment.
3. Set `base_url` (default `http://localhost:8081`), `test_user_email`, and the sample `contact_number`/`reason`/`requested_speciality`.
4. Run **Start Consultation** first — its Tests script saves `call_log`/`call_url` into the environment for the next two requests.
5. Requires `Shukhee Settings.base_url`/`video_call_base_url` and a matching `UHIS Shukhee User` to already be configured on the target site — see this app's README.

item.name: 1. Consultation
item.description: shukhee_integration.api.consultation — the client-facing flow. All three requests share one `call_log` (captured from Start Consultation into the environment).

formdata.description: Must match an existing Patient.phone on this site -- the Shukhee-side patient is resolved/created from that Patient's name/dob/gender, never fabricated.
Free text, e.g. 'General Medicine'. Matched case-insensitively against Shukhee's live specialities list; falls back to the first available speciality if no title match.
Optional. Plain identifier from the app, carried through with no FK validation, same as patient_id.
Optional. Select up to 10 files in the Postman UI -- src can't be pre-filled in a shared collection file. Uploaded to Shukhee once, together, before booking.

request.description:
Books an instant call with Shukhee and creates one Call Logs row. This is the diagram's "Backend gets call URL + status = ConsultationStarted" step -- the client should transition off the loading screen once this returns and open `call_url` in a WebView.

Response: `{ message: { call_log, call_url, status } }` (status will be `pending`).

exec: console.log('[Shukhee Integration] call_url (open in WebView to join):', data.call_url);

request.description:
Poll this on an interval while on the video-call/loader screens. If the stored status is already terminal (`completed`/`rejected`/`cancelled`/`on-hold`) this returns the cached row with **no external call to Shukhee**; otherwise it checks live and updates.

The diagram's `ConsultationEnd` state is not a separate call -- it's a client-observed transition (the WebView redirects/closes when the doctor ends the call). Keep polling this endpoint; once Shukhee's own status reaches `completed`, `prescription_link`/`invoice_link` will be populated (downloaded and re-hosted by the server, not Shukhee's raw presigned link).

Response: `{ message: { status, prescription_link, invoice_link } }`.

exec: console.log('[Shukhee Integration] status:', data.status, '-- prescription_link:', data.prescription_link, '-- invoice_link:', data.invoice_link);

request.description:
"View Prescription" button. Returns the already-downloaded prescription/invoice links for a completed consultation -- fails with a clear error if the consultation hasn't reached `completed` yet (run **Get Consultation Status** until it has).

Response: `{ message: { prescription_link, invoice_link } }`. Both are permanent `/private/files/...` URLs on this site, not Shukhee's short-lived presigned S3 links.

exec: console.log('[Shukhee Integration] prescription_link:', data.prescription_link, '-- invoice_link:', data.invoice_link);
